# EMBER & SAGE — Full Restaurant Information

## Overview

EMBER & SAGE is a contemporary fine-dining restaurant located in Portland, Oregon. Founded in 2018 by Chef Marcus Bellini, the restaurant is known for beautifully presented food, warm hospitality, and a refined dining experience that engages all the senses.

The name "EMBER & SAGE" reflects the dual elements that define the cooking — the primal warmth of fire (ember) and the refined elegance of fresh herbs (sage).

## Address & Contact

- Address: 127 Ember Lane, Portland, OR 97201
- Phone: (503) 555-0142
- Email: hello@emberandsage.com
- Website: https://emberandsage.com

## Hours of Operation

- Monday through Thursday: 5:00 PM to 10:00 PM
- Friday and Saturday: 5:00 PM to 11:00 PM
- Sunday: 10:00 AM to 9:00 PM
- Brunch (Saturday and Sunday): 10:00 AM to 2:00 PM

## Chef Marcus Bellini — Executive Chef & Co-Founder

Born in Milan and trained in some of Europe's most prestigious kitchens, Chef Marcus brings over 20 years of culinary expertise to EMBER & SAGE. His journey has taken him from the Michelin-starred restaurants of Paris to the vibrant food scenes of New York and Tokyo.

His philosophy is rooted in respect — for the ingredients, for the techniques, and for the guests who entrust him with their dining experience. "Cooking is an act of generosity," he often says. "Every dish should tell a story and create a memory."

Under his leadership, EMBER & SAGE has earned recognition for its innovative approach to modern cuisine while maintaining the warmth and hospitality that makes guests feel at home.

## Philosophy

Founded in 2018, EMBER & SAGE was born from a simple yet profound belief: that dining should be an experience that engages all the senses. The name reflects the dual elements that define the cooking — the primal warmth of fire and the refined elegance of fresh herbs.

Every dish honors traditional techniques while embracing modern innovation. Ingredients are sourced from local farmers and artisans who share the commitment to quality and sustainability.

## Services

- Dine-in
- Reservations (online, phone, or walk-in)
- Private dining for special events
- Brunch service (Saturday and Sunday)
- Takeout

## Dietary Accommodations

The restaurant offers vegetarian, vegan, and gluten-free options. Please inform staff of any allergies when making a reservation or ordering.

## Parking

Valet parking available on Friday and Saturday evenings. Street parking and nearby public parking garages available.

## Private Dining

Private dining rooms available for parties of 12 or more. Perfect for corporate events, celebrations, and intimate gatherings. Contact the restaurant for details.
